item.title: Ascent: $45 Million Series C Raised For Student Lending Platform
item.description: Ascent, a San Diego-based student lending platform, announced it has closed a $45 million Series C financing round amid shifting federal loan policies that are driving increased demand for private education financing. The new capital comes as caps on federal student loans push more graduate students and career-focused learners toward private lenders to cover tuition gaps.
